actions.add_to_queue.description: Add an existing file (API-uploaded or user-file) to the print queue. For uploading a new file at the same time, use "Upload File & Add to Queue".
actions.add_to_queue.props.amount.descri: Number of copies to queue (defaults to 1).
actions.add_to_queue.props.apiFileId.des: Hex id returned by Upload File. Required when source is "API file".
actions.add_to_queue.props.bedType.descr: Printer bed surface. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.
Optional. Object keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value. PRINT_QUEUE category is auto-applied.
actions.add_to_queue.props.customTags.de: Custom tags to apply. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file (if applicable).
actions.add_to_queue.props.fileSource.op: API file (hex id from Upload File action)
actions.add_to_queue.props.forModels.des: Restrict to printers of specific models. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file (if applicable). Built from the models your printers are using.
actions.add_to_queue.props.forPrinters.d: Restrict this queue item to one or more specific printers. Leave empty to allow any eligible printer.
actions.add_to_queue.props.groupId.descr: Which queue group to add the item to. Required if your account has queue groups configured. Leave empty only if no queue groups exist.
actions.add_to_queue.props.nozzleSize.de: Target nozzle diameter, e.g. `0.4`. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.
actions.add_to_queue.props.nozzleType.de: Nozzle material. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.
actions.add_to_queue.props.nozzleVolumeT: Nozzle flow category. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.
actions.add_to_queue.props.position.desc: Where in the queue to place the new item.
actions.add_to_queue.props.positionNumbe: Only used when "Insert at" is "Specific position". 1-based index (1 = very top). Requires queue-reorder permission.
actions.add_to_queue.props.userFileUid.d: UID of an existing user-file (from "List Files"). Required when source is "User file". Accepts only the single file UID string.
actions.adjust_filament_weight.descripti: Update the remaining filament on a spool. Provide ONE of "grams remaining" / "percent remaining" / "weighed gross" — the other two derive from it.
actions.adjust_filament_weight.props.emp: Override the empty spool weight used for the gross calculation.
actions.adjust_filament_weight.props.fil: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag.
actions.adjust_filament_weight.props.gra: Net grams of filament left on the spool.
actions.adjust_filament_weight.props.per: Alternative to grams — share of the spool still on the reel.
actions.adjust_filament_weight.props.sav: Persist empty spool weight on spool record
actions.adjust_filament_weight.props.wei: Total weight including the empty spool. Combine with "subtract empty spool" to compute net.
actions.approve_queue_item.description: Approve one or more pending queue items.
actions.approve_queue_item.props.queueIt: Numeric IDs of pending queue items to approve.
actions.archive_print_jobs.description: Archive one or more completed print jobs (removes them from the active history view).
Optional note explaining why the jobs were archived (max 500 chars).
actions.assign_filament.description: Assign a filament spool to a printer at a specific nozzle + extruder slot. Defaults to nozzle 0 / extruder 0 (single-nozzle single-extruder printers); set the indices for multi-nozzle (e.g. IDEX, toolchanger) or multi-material (MMS, MMU) printers.
actions.assign_filament.props.extruderIn: Which extruder on the chosen nozzle (0-based). Use 0 for single-extruder nozzles. Multi-material setups (MMS, MMU, AMS) use 1+ for the additional extruders feeding the same nozzle. Backend rejects with "Extruder out of range" if the nozzle doesn't have this many extruders.
actions.assign_filament.props.filamentId: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag.
actions.assign_filament.props.nozzleInde: Which nozzle on the printer (0-based). Use 0 for single-nozzle printers. Multi-nozzle printers (IDEX, toolchanger) use 1+ for the additional nozzles. Backend rejects with "Nozzle out of range" if the printer doesn't have this many nozzles.
Numeric printer ID. In automation flows this typically flows in from a trigger or upstream step.
actions.assign_tag.description: Attach an existing custom tag to a printer, printer group, file, or queue item. Use "Create or Update Tag" first to get the tag ID.
actions.assign_tag.props.override.descri: When true, replaces the subject's current custom tags. When false (default), merges with existing tags.
actions.assign_tag.props.subjectIds.desc: Numeric IDs (or UID strings for files) of the entities to tag. Provide one or many.
actions.assign_tag.props.subjectType.des: What kind of entity to tag.
actions.assign_tag.props.tagIds.descript: Numeric custom tag IDs to attach. From "List Tags" or "Create or Update Tag".
actions.cancel_pending_print.description: Cancel a print that's queued/staged on a printer but hasn't started yet (status = print_pending). Distinct from "Cancel Print", which targets the active print.
actions.cancel_pending_print.props.print: Numeric printer IDs whose pending prints should be cancelled.
actions.cancel_print.description: Cancel the current print on a printer. This is destructive — the job cannot be resumed.
actions.cancel_print.props.printerId.des: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.clear_printer_bed.description: Mark a printer's bed as cleared after a print finishes. Bread-and-butter step in AutoPrint flows — pair with a "print done" trigger to automate bed clearing.
actions.clear_printer_bed.props.autoPrin: When checked, resets the AutoPrint cleared-bed counter on the printer.
actions.clear_printer_bed.props.rating.d: Optional 1-4 star rating for the just-finished print.
Was the bed actually cleared (true) or did it fail (false)? Drives AutoPrint clear-count logic.
actions.create_filament.description: Add a new filament spool to your inventory. Use the free-text brand/color fields for ad-hoc spools or the catalog ids for known SKUs.
actions.create_filament.props.amount.des: Create N identical spools at once (capped at 500). Defaults to 1.
actions.create_filament.props.brand.desc: Free-text brand name (always required, even when catalog ids are set).
actions.create_filament.props.colorHex.d: Hex color (e.g. `#FF8800`). For multi-color spools, comma-separate (e.g. `#FF8800,#0044CC`).
actions.create_filament.props.cost.descr: Optional. Spool cost in account currency (cents/whole-units depending on your currency).
actions.create_filament.props.filamentTy: Numeric id of the material type / profile (look up via "List Filaments" results — `type.id` on each spool — or via your filament management page). EITHER this OR a "Catalog filament ID" (+ optional "Catalog variant ID") pair is required when creating a new spool — the backend uses the catalog chain to auto-resolve / auto-import a profile. Throws "The Filament type is required" if neither is set.
actions.create_filament.props.lengthRema: Amount of filament still on the spool. For a brand-new untouched spool, set this equal to "Total length / weight". For a partially-used spool, set this lower. Same unit as "Length type". (Backend's `length_used` POST param is, despite its name, semantically "remaining" — see Create.php math.)
actions.create_filament.props.locationId: Optional. Numeric id of the storage location.
actions.create_filament.props.nfcId.desc: Optional. NFC tag identifier for app tracking.
actions.create_filament.props.qrId.descr: Optional. 4-character short id printed on the spool QR sticker. Auto-generated if omitted.
actions.create_filament.props.totalLengt: Spool size — interpretation depends on "Length type" below. Required when creating a new spool.
Unit for "Total length / weight" and "Length used".
actions.create_folder.description: Create a new folder in the user file system, or update an existing one (pass the folder ID to edit). Optionally an "organization" / shared folder with per-rank view/upload/modify permissions.
actions.create_folder.props.folderId.des: Numeric ID of the folder to edit. Omit to create a new folder.
Only used when "Shared folder" is true. Numeric user rank IDs allowed to modify / delete contents.
actions.create_folder.props.org.descript: When true, the folder is shared across the company per the rank-based permissions below. Requires the Shared Folders feature.
actions.create_folder.props.parentFolder: Numeric ID of the parent folder. Use 0 for root.
Only used when "Shared folder" is true. Numeric user rank IDs allowed to upload to the folder.
actions.create_folder.props.viewRanks.de: Only used when "Shared folder" is true. Numeric user rank IDs allowed to view the folder.
actions.create_tag.description: Create a new custom tag, or rename / re-style an existing one (pass the tag ID to edit).
actions.create_tag.props.badge.descripti: Bootstrap badge color used to render the tag.
actions.create_tag.props.tagId.descripti: Numeric tag ID to edit. Omit to create a new tag.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Call any SimplyPrint REST endpoint the piece does not wrap directly. Useful for admin / partner / school-dashboard endpoints and anything else behind OAuth scopes.
actions.custom_api_call.props.includeRes: Return `{ body, headers, status }` instead of just the body.
actions.custom_api_call.props.path.descr: Endpoint path relative to the account, e.g. "printers/Get" or "queue/AddItem". Do not include the host or the account ID segment.
actions.delete_files.description: Permanently delete one or more user files by UID. Returns a partial-success report — files the caller can't modify are reported in `errors` while accessible files are deleted.
actions.delete_files.props.fileUids.desc: UID strings of the files to delete. Look up via "List Files".
actions.delete_folders.description: Delete one or more folders (and everything in them). All-or-nothing: if any folder isn't modifiable by the caller, the whole call fails.
actions.delete_queue_group.description: Delete a queue group. Items in the group are moved to "Move to" group, or to the first remaining group if not specified, or set to ungrouped if it was the last group.
actions.delete_queue_group.props.groupId: Numeric ID of the queue group to delete.
Optional target group ID for orphaned items. If omitted, items go to the first remaining group (or become ungrouped if this is the last).
actions.delete_tag.description: Delete a custom tag from the account. The tag is removed from every printer/file/queue item it was attached to.
actions.delete_tag.props.tagId.descripti: Numeric custom tag ID to delete.
actions.deny_queue_item.description: Deny a pending queue item (remove or send back for revision).
actions.deny_queue_item.props.comment.de: Explain why the item is being denied. Shown to the submitter.
actions.deny_queue_item.props.requestRev: When checked, the submitter can edit and resubmit. Otherwise the item is removed.
actions.detach_tag.description: Remove a single custom tag from one printer, printer group, file, or queue item.
actions.detach_tag.props.subjectId.descr: Numeric ID (or UID string for files) of the entity to detach the tag from.
actions.detach_tag.props.tagId.descripti: Numeric custom tag ID to remove.
actions.download_file.description: Download a file from SimplyPrint by user-file UID, queue-item ID, or print-job UID. Returns the file as an Activepieces file reference plus content-type / size metadata.
actions.download_file.props.filename.des: Name to store the downloaded file under in AP. Defaults to the Content-Disposition value or the identifier.
actions.download_file.props.identifier.d: UID for "User file" / "Print job", numeric ID for "Queue item". Look these up via "List Files" / "List Print History" / "List Queue Items".
actions.download_file.props.source.descr: Which kind of file to fetch.
actions.empty_queue.description: Delete every item from the print queue (optionally filtered to a group or done-only). Destructive.
actions.empty_queue.props.doneOnly.descr: When checked, only done items are removed. Pending / printing / failed items stay.
actions.empty_queue.props.groupId.descri: Which queue group to add the item to. Required if your account has queue groups configured. Leave empty only if no queue groups exist.
actions.get_current_user.description: Return information about the SimplyPrint account connected to this flow.
actions.get_farm_overview.description: One-shot fleet summary: total printer count plus per-bucket lists (online/offline, printing/paused, awaiting bed clear, in maintenance, requires-attention, AI failure detections, …). Use this instead of paginating "List Printers" when you just need counts and the printers in each state.
actions.get_filament.description: Get detailed information about a specific filament spool by numeric ID or 4-character short ID (uid).
actions.get_filament.props.filamentId.de: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag. In automation flows this typically comes from a previous step (trigger payload, MCP response, etc.).
actions.get_filament_history.description: Paginated usage history for a specific spool — print jobs, weight adjustments, drying cycles, etc.
actions.get_filament_history.props.filam: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag.
actions.get_filament_history.props.perPa: Items per page (max 100). Defaults to backend default.
actions.get_next_queue_items.description: Resolve the next-up queue items for one or more printers using the company's match criteria (with deduplication so the same item is never assigned twice). Returns the matched queue object with item references per printer.
actions.get_next_queue_items.props.desel: Optional. Printer IDs to skip when matching (e.g. printers currently busy).
actions.get_next_queue_items_for_printer: Read-only preview of the next-up queue item for each given printer (no dedup, no offline checks). For each printer, returns either the matched queue item or the issues blocking a match. Different from "Get Next Queue Items": that one dedupes for actual scheduling, this one shows what each printer would pick.
Preview Next Queue Items per Printer
actions.get_print_job.description: Fetch a single print job's full record by its UID — timeline, pictures, spools used, gcode analysis, filament data, cost, AI inference, custom fields, etc.
actions.get_print_job.props.includeCusto: When true, also returns the schema for the custom fields attached to the job (vs just values).
actions.get_print_job.props.jobUid.descr: Print job UID string (typically 10+ characters). Comes from "List Print History" results or webhook payloads.
actions.get_printer.description: Get detailed information about a specific printer.
actions.get_printer.props.printerId.desc: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.get_printer_notifications.descri: Fetch the open notifications/events on one or more printers. Pairs well with the `requires_attention` bucket from "Get Farm Overview".
actions.get_queue_item.description: Fetch a single queue item by numeric ID — returns the formatted record (file metadata, assignments, custom fields, …).
actions.get_queue_item.props.queueItemId: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.get_statistics.description: Fetch high-level printing statistics (total prints, materials used, hours, etc.).
actions.list_custom_fields.description: List all custom field definitions on your account.
Optional — e.g. PRINT_QUEUE, FILE, USER. Leave empty to list all.
actions.list_custom_fields.props.page.de: Specific page number (1-based). Leave empty to walk all pages and return every field.
actions.list_custom_fields.props.pageSiz: Items per page (max 100). Defaults to 100 when paging is requested.
actions.list_filaments.description: List filament spools in your SimplyPrint account, with optional filters and sort.
actions.list_filaments.props.assigned.de: Whether to include only assigned spools, only unassigned, or both.
actions.list_filaments.props.brand.descr: Substring match against brand name. Leave empty for no filter.
actions.list_filaments.props.color.descr: Substring match against color name, hex, or group. Leave empty for no filter.
actions.list_filaments.props.empty.descr: Filter by empty / non-empty status. "Empty" means filament left ≤ 0 or marked as emptied.
actions.list_filaments.props.limit.descr: Cap on returned spools (1–100). Leave empty for no cap. Backend has no offset-pagination on this endpoint, so this is the only cap available.
actions.list_filaments.props.materialTyp: Substring match against material type, e.g. `PLA`, `PETG`. Leave empty for no filter.
actions.list_filaments.props.printerId.d: Only return spools currently assigned to this printer (numeric ID).
actions.list_filaments.props.sortBy.desc: Field to sort the result list by. Leave empty to use backend default ordering.
actions.list_filaments.props.sortDir.des: Only applied when "Sort by" is set.
actions.list_files.description: List files in your SimplyPrint account, optionally within a folder and/or filtered by a search term.
actions.list_files.props.folderId.descri: Leave empty (or 0) to list root-level files. Use -1 for the "all files" flat view.
actions.list_files.props.globalSearch.de: When a search term is provided, search across every folder instead of just the current one.
actions.list_pending_queue_items.descrip: List queue items awaiting approval, denied, or sent back for revision.
actions.list_pending_queue_items.props.p: Items per page (max 100). Defaults to 50 (backend default).
actions.list_pending_queue_items.props.s: Restrict to a single approval status. Defaults to all (pending + denied + revision).
actions.list_print_history.description: List completed print jobs, optionally filtered to a single printer.
actions.list_print_history.props.limit.d: Maximum number of jobs to return per page (default 25, max 100).
actions.list_print_history.props.printer: Restrict to jobs from a specific printer. Leave empty for all printers.
actions.list_printers.description: List every printer in your SimplyPrint account with current status.
actions.list_printers.props.page.descrip: Specific page number (1-based). Leave empty to walk all pages and return every printer.
actions.list_printers.props.pageSize.des: Items per page (max 100). Defaults to 100 when paging is requested.
actions.list_queue.description: List items in the print queue, optionally filtered to a single queue group.
actions.list_queue.props.groupId.descrip: Numeric queue group ID to filter by. Leave empty for the whole queue.
actions.list_queue.props.page.descriptio: Page number (1-based). Only applies to the active-queue path; ignored when "Include completed items" is on.
actions.list_queue_groups.description: List every queue group on your account.
actions.list_tags.description: List all custom tags configured on your account.
actions.mark_filament_dried.description: Record that one or more spools were just dried. Updates each spool's last-dried timestamp.
actions.mark_filament_dried.props.driedA: When drying completed. Defaults to now if omitted (e.g. `2026-04-26T12:34:00Z`).
actions.mark_filament_dried.props.filame: Spool IDs (numeric) or 4-character short IDs (uid) — comma-separated short IDs are resolved one-by-one. Pure numeric values skip the lookup round-trip.
actions.move_file.description: Move one or more user files to a different folder.
actions.move_file.props.fileUids.descrip: User-file UID string. Comma-separate to move several files at once. Use "List Files" to look up UIDs.
actions.move_file.props.targetFolderId.d: Destination folder. Use 0 for the root folder.
actions.move_queue_item.description: Move a queue item to a different queue group.
actions.move_queue_item.props.queueItemI: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.move_queue_item.props.targetGrou: Numeric ID of the destination queue group.
actions.pause_print.description: Pause the current print on a printer.
actions.pause_print.props.printerId.desc: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.remove_from_queue.description: Remove an item from the print queue. Destructive — the item is gone.
actions.remove_from_queue.props.queueIte: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.resolve_printer_notification.des: Mark a printer notification as resolved (or dismissed). For notifications with multiple actions, pass `action` to pick one or `force: true` to resolve without choosing.
actions.resolve_printer_notification.pro: For multi-action notifications, the action key to invoke. Leave empty for single-action or dismiss-only notifications.
Mark as dismissed rather than resolved.
Resolve immediately even if multiple actions are available (skips picking one).
Numeric notification event ID. Use "Get Printer Notifications" to look it up.
Numeric printer ID the notification belongs to.
actions.resume_print.description: Resume a paused print on a printer.
actions.resume_print.props.printerId.des: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.revive_queue_item.description: Bring a completed (done) queue item back to the active queue.
actions.revive_queue_item.props.queueIte: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.save_queue_group.description: Create or update a queue group. Pass an existing group ID to edit it; omit it to create a new one. Requires the Queue Groups feature on the account.
actions.save_queue_group.props.acceptedE: File extensions allowed in this group (without the dot, e.g. `gcode`, `bgcode`). Leave empty for "any".
actions.save_queue_group.props.approvalE: Optional. User ranks whose submissions skip approval.
actions.save_queue_group.props.approvalR: Optional. User ranks whose submissions need approval.
actions.save_queue_group.props.forGroups: Optional. Restrict this group to specific printer groups.
actions.save_queue_group.props.forModels: Optional. Restrict this group to specific printer models.
actions.save_queue_group.props.forPrinte: Optional. Restrict this group to specific printers.
actions.save_queue_group.props.groupId.d: Numeric ID of the group to edit. Omit to create a new group.
actions.save_queue_group.props.name.desc: Display name for the group (max 64 chars).
actions.save_queue_group.props.requiresA: Master toggle for approval workflow on this group.
actions.save_queue_group.props.virtualOn: When true, no real queue items can be added — used for placeholder/grouping-only groups.
actions.save_queue_group.props.visibilit: Optional. Limit who can see the group based on user rank IDs.
actions.send_gcode.description: Send raw G-code commands to an operational printer (requires Print Farm plan).
actions.send_gcode.props.gcode.descripti: One G-code command per line, e.g. "G28" then "M104 S200". Up to 200 lines per request.
actions.send_gcode.props.printerId.descr: Numeric printer ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.set_custom_field_values.descript: Set custom field values on one or more entities (queue items, files, printers, etc.).
actions.set_custom_field_values.props.ca: Entity category the fields belong to.
actions.set_custom_field_values.props.en: Numeric IDs of the target entities.
actions.set_custom_field_values.props.su: Only applicable for the "print" category. Pick the specific entity type the fields belong to.
actions.set_custom_field_values.props.va: Object keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value. Converted to the backend submission array automatically.
actions.set_printer_out_of_order.descrip: Mark one or more printers as out-of-order (or clear that flag). Requires the Out-of-Order feature on the account.
actions.set_printer_out_of_order.props.o: True = mark as out-of-order. False = clear the flag.
actions.set_queue_item_printers.descript: Assign one or more queue items to specific printers, printer models, and/or printer groups. Replaces the current assignments on each item.
actions.set_queue_item_printers.props.gr: Numeric printer group IDs. Leave empty to clear group assignments.
actions.set_queue_item_printers.props.mo: Numeric printer model IDs. Leave empty to clear model assignments.
actions.set_queue_item_printers.props.pr: Numeric printer IDs to assign to. Leave empty to clear printer assignments.
actions.set_queue_item_printers.props.qu: Numeric queue item IDs to update.
actions.skip_print_objects.description: Skip one or more individual model objects on the current print (printer must be in PRINTING / PAUSED / PAUSING / CANCELLING / RESUMING state). Single printer per call.
actions.skip_print_objects.props.objectI: Numeric indices of the objects to skip (as exposed by the slicer / printer's object list).
actions.skip_print_objects.props.printer: Numeric printer ID of the active print.
actions.start_print.description: Start a print job on one or more printers from an existing file, queue item, or print-job reference.
actions.start_print.props.apiFileId.desc: Required when source is "API file". Hex hash returned by Upload File.
actions.start_print.props.fileSource.des: Which kind of existing reference to start from.
actions.start_print.props.fileSource.opt: API file (hash from Upload File action)
actions.start_print.props.individualCust: Optional. JSON array `[{"id": <queueItemId>, "value": {"<fieldId>": <value>}}]`. Per-item PRINT_JOB custom fields when starting a multi-queue job.
actions.start_print.props.mmsMap.descrip: Optional. JSON object mapping printer id → multi-material slot configuration. Leave empty for single-material printers.
actions.start_print.props.printerIds.des: Pick one or more printers from your account.
actions.start_print.props.sharedCustomFi: Custom-field values applied to every started job (PRINT_JOB). Keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value.
actions.start_print.props.startOptions.d: Optional slicer/print-time metadata (nozzle, filament_material, print_speed, layer_height, infill, quality). Arbitrary keys allowed.
actions.start_print.props.userFileUid.de: Required when source is "User file". The UserFile.uid string.
actions.unarchive_print_jobs.description: Restore one or more archived print jobs to the active history view.
actions.unassign_filament.description: Detach a specific filament spool from whichever printer it is currently assigned to.
actions.unassign_filament.props.filament: Numeric spool ID, OR the 4-character short ID (`uid`) printed on the QR sticker / NFC tag.
actions.update_file.description: Rename a user file and / or update its compatible-printer assignments. (Thumbnail upload is not exposed here — multipart isn't supported on this endpoint over OAuth via the AP HTTP client.)
actions.update_file.props.fileUid.descri: UID string of the file to update (10-36 chars). Look up via "List Files".
actions.update_file.props.name.descripti: New display name (max 256 chars). Keep the existing extension — backend infers file type from it.
actions.update_file.props.printerIds.des: Numeric printer IDs the file is allowed to print on. Leave empty to clear printer-restriction.
actions.update_file.props.printerModelId: Numeric model IDs the file is allowed to print on. Leave empty to clear model-restriction.
actions.update_file.props.removeThumbnai: When true, deletes any thumbnail currently stored on the file.
actions.update_queue_item.description: Update a queue item (amount, note, etc.).
actions.update_queue_item.props.queueIte: Numeric queue item ID. Typically piped in from an upstream step.
actions.upload_and_queue.description: Upload a local file or HTTPS URL to SimplyPrint and add it to the print queue in one step. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically. For starting the print afterwards, chain a "Start Print" action.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.amount.de: Number of copies to queue (defaults to 1).
actions.upload_and_queue.props.bedType.d: Printer bed surface. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.customFie: Optional. Object keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value. PRINT_QUEUE category is auto-applied.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.customTag: Custom tags to apply. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file (if applicable).
actions.upload_and_queue.props.file.desc: File data (G-code, STL, 3MF). Used if "File URL" is empty. AP materializes the whole file into RAM before this action runs — for very large files prefer the File URL input below.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.fileUrl.d: Alternative to File — an HTTPS URL the piece will stream directly to SimplyPrint without buffering the whole file in memory. Recommended for files over ~500 MB. The URL must return a Content-Length header (S3 pre-signed URLs, Dropbox raw links, etc.). If set, the File input is ignored.
Name to store the file under on SimplyPrint. MUST include the correct extension (e.g. .gcode, .stl, .3mf) — the backend picks the file type from the extension, not the contents. Required when using File URL unless the URL path ends in a filename with an extension. Optional with File (defaults to source filename).
actions.upload_and_queue.props.forModels: Restrict to printers of specific models. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file (if applicable). Built from the models your printers are using.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.forPrinte: Restrict this queue item to one or more specific printers. Leave empty to allow any eligible printer.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.groupId.d: Which queue group to add the item to. Required if your account has queue groups configured. Leave empty only if no queue groups exist.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.nozzleSiz: Target nozzle diameter, e.g. `0.4`. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.nozzleTyp: Nozzle material. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.nozzleVol: Nozzle flow category. Leave empty to auto-tag from the gcode file.
Where in the queue to place the new item.
actions.upload_and_queue.props.positionN: Only used when "Insert at" is "Specific position". 1-based index (1 = very top). Requires queue-reorder permission.
actions.upload_file.description: Upload a file or HTTPS URL to SimplyPrint. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically. Returns the API file id — pass it to "Add File to Queue" or "Start Print" later.
actions.upload_file.props.file.descripti: File data (G-code, STL, 3MF). Used if "File URL" is empty. AP materializes the whole file into RAM before this action runs — for very large files prefer the File URL input below.
actions.upload_file.props.fileUrl.descri: Alternative to File — an HTTPS URL the piece will stream directly to SimplyPrint without buffering the whole file in memory. Recommended for files over ~500 MB. The URL must return a Content-Length header (S3 pre-signed URLs, Dropbox raw links, signed Google Drive download URLs, etc.). If set, the File input is ignored.
actions.upload_file.props.filename.descr: Name to store the file under on SimplyPrint. MUST include the correct extension (e.g. .gcode, .stl, .3mf) — the backend picks the file type from the extension, not the contents. Required when using File URL unless the URL path ends in a filename with an extension. Optional with File (defaults to source filename).
actions.upload_to_folder.description: Upload a file (or HTTPS URL) and save it to your SimplyPrint user file system, optionally inside a specific folder. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically.
actions.upload_to_folder.props.customFie: Optional. Object keyed by custom-field UUID (fieldId) → value. PRINT category / USER_FILE sub-category is auto-applied.
actions.upload_to_folder.props.file.desc: File data (G-code, STL, 3MF). Used if "File URL" is empty. AP materializes the whole file into RAM before this action runs — for very large files prefer the File URL input below.
actions.upload_to_folder.props.fileUrl.d: Alternative to File — an HTTPS URL the piece will stream directly to SimplyPrint without buffering the whole file in memory. Recommended for files over ~500 MB. The URL must return a Content-Length header (S3 pre-signed URLs, Dropbox raw links, etc.). If set, the File input is ignored.
Name to store the file under on SimplyPrint. MUST include the correct extension (e.g. .gcode, .stl, .3mf) — the backend picks the file type from the extension, not the contents. Required when using File URL unless the URL path ends in a filename with an extension. Optional with File (defaults to source filename).
Numeric ID of the destination folder. Use 0 (or leave empty) to save to the root of the user file system. Look up folder IDs with the "List Files" action.

triggers.bed_cleared.description: Fires when a printer's bed is reported cleared (ready for the next job).
